benefits.text:
BBIA Last Velvet Tint Re-new Version is a vegan velvet lip cream, an improved version of BBIA's iconic Last Velvet Tint line, standing out with a soft, smooth velvet texture that feels light on the lips and blends easily. It gives a clear layer of color while keeping a smooth, velvety matte effect, helping lips look softer, neater and with more depth without making the overall makeup look heavy. The formula has been improved to increase color hold, color payoff and comfort during use, suitable for both a natural gradient lip and a sharp full-lip look.
1. Improved velvet texture: soft and smooth like velvet, light on the lips, easy to blend and minimizes a thick feeling on the lips.
2. 28-shade palette: ranging from nude base and natural MLBB to deeper point shades, easy to choose for many skin tones and makeup styles.
3. Two texture effects: MOIST VELVET for a softer, moist velvet feel and SOFT VELVET for a smooth matte velvet finish that is neater and more vivid.

The Renew version not only changes the shade range but also comprehensively upgrades the user experience, from the lipstick texture and color hold to the packaging design. The frosted transparent case lets you clearly see the lip color and texture inside, creating a modern, minimal feel and making each shade easy to identify. With its signature “velvet tint” spirit, BBIA Last Velvet Tint Re-new Version suits those who want an easy-to-use matte lip cream line for everyday wear, with many color options, a smooth, beautiful finish on the lips and flexibility across natural, office, going-out or seasonal makeup.

Apply a layer of lip balm before using the lipstick for softer, smoother lips (optional).
Apply the lipstick directly to the lips, starting from the center and blending out toward the corners.
You can reapply after eating or drinking to keep the color fresh.

benefits.text:
BBIA Last Velvet Tint Re-new Version is a vegan velvet lip cream, an improved version of BBIA's iconic Last Velvet Tint line, standing out with a soft, smooth velvet texture that feels light on the lips and blends easily. It gives a clear layer of color while keeping a smooth, velvety matte effect, helping lips look softer, neater and with more depth without making the overall makeup look heavy. The formula has been improved to increase color hold, color payoff and comfort during use, suitable for both a natural gradient lip and a sharp full-lip look.
1. Improved velvet texture: soft and smooth like velvet, light on the lips, easy to blend and minimizes a thick feeling on the lips.
2. 28-shade palette: ranging from nude base and natural MLBB to deeper point shades, easy to choose for many skin tones and makeup styles.
3. Two texture effects: MOIST VELVET for a softer, moist velvet feel and SOFT VELVET for a smooth matte velvet finish that is neater and more vivid.

The Renew version not only changes the shade range but also comprehensively upgrades the user experience, from the lipstick texture and color hold to the packaging design. The frosted transparent case lets you clearly see the lip color and texture inside, creating a modern, minimal feel and making each shade easy to identify. With its signature “velvet tint” spirit, BBIA Last Velvet Tint Re-new Version suits those who want an easy-to-use matte lip cream line for everyday wear, with many color options, a smooth, beautiful finish on the lips and flexibility across natural, office, going-out or seasonal makeup.
